info.description: HTTP API of dumpstore, a web UI for ZFS and file sharing. Generated from the server's route registry (internal/apispec). Dataset, snapshot and device names contain '/' and '@' — percent-encode them in path parameters. Every write accepts an optional X-Operation-ID header; its progress steps are published on the ansible.progress SSE topic and the result can be fetched from GET /api/operations/{id}.
info.title: dumpstore API
